z-m-38-03.title: A maganin Minjun na √(x+2)=x, wane layi ne ba daidai ba?
z-m-38-03.topic: Mafita ga ma'aunin marar ma'ana da mafita na bogi (sharuddan maganganu marasa ma'ana)
z-m-38-03.goal: A cikin maganin ma'aunin marar ma'ana da aka ɗaga ɓangarorin biyu murabba'i, nemo layin da ba a yi masa gwaji ba, ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa aka cire wata mafita, sannan ka gina ma'auni da irin wannan yanayi.
z-m-38-03.material: x lamba ce ta ainihi. Minjun ya warware ma'aunin √(x+2) = x (ana karanta shi: 'tushen murabba'i na x da aka ƙara da 2 daidai yake da x') kuma ya rubuta aikin da ke ƙasa. Malami ya ce, “Mai yiwuwa ba amsa guda ɗaya ba ce, don haka duba ko akwai layin maganin da ba a tabbatar da shi ba.”

z-m-38-03.thinking.2: Kai da kanka ka tsara sabuwar tambaya mai irin wannan tsari

z-m-38-03.prereq.3: Dangantaka tsakanin tushen ma'auni da ma'aunansa (jimilla da ninkin tushen biyu)
z-m-38-03.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi ɗaya na maganin da yake da kuskure. (Ƙirga layukan daga 1.)
z-m-38-03.s.s1.hint.0: Saka x = 2 da x = −1, kowannensu, a cikin ainihin ma'aunin √(x+2) = x, sannan ka lissafa ɓangaren hagu da na dama dabam.
z-m-38-03.s.s1.line.0: Idan aka ɗaga ɓangarorin biyu murabba'i, ana samun x + 2 = x²
z-m-38-03.s.s1.line.3: Idan x = −1, abin da ke ƙarƙashin tushen shi ne −1 + 2 = 1, wanda ba mara kyau ba ne, saboda haka ƙimomin biyu mafita ne ga wannan ma'auni
z-m-38-03.s.s1.explain: Layi na 4 ne ba daidai ba. Idan ka saka x = −1 cikin ainihin ma'aunin, ɓangaren hagu ya zama √1 = 1, na dama kuma −1; don haka ba su yi daidai ba. Abin da ya kamata a gwada ba wai ko 'abin da ke ƙarƙashin tushen ba mara kyau ba ne', sai dai ko 'ainihin ma'aunin ya cika'. Lissafin layuka 1 zuwa 3 daidai ne.
z-m-38-03.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi duk bayanan da suka dace na dalilin da ya sa aka cire x = −1 daga mafita.
z-m-38-03.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko ka rubuta kewayon ƙimomin da √(x+2) zai iya samu, sannan ka yi tunanin sharadin da hakan ya ɗora wa x a ɓangaren dama.
z-m-38-03.s.s2.hint.1: Yi amfani da ma'aunin da ya ba da x + 2 = x² kamar haka ga √(x+2) = −x.
z-m-38-03.s.s2.o.a: Bayan ɗaga murabba'i, √(x+2)=x da √(x+2)=−x duka sun zama x+2=x² iri ɗaya, saboda haka ba za a iya bambance su ba
z-m-38-03.s.s2.r.a: Wannan bayani ya gane cewa ɗaga murabba'i yana share bayani game da alamar ƙima.
z-m-38-03.s.s2.o.b: Bayan ɗaga murabba'i, koyaushe ana samun mafita guda ɗaya fiye da ta ainihin ma'aunin, saboda haka dole ne a cire ɗaya daga cikin mafita da aka samu
z-m-38-03.s.s2.r.b: Ɗaga murabba'i ba koyaushe yake ƙara wata mafita guda ba. Za ka iya ganin rashin ingancin wannan gama-garin da'awa ta hanyar gwada ma'auni kamar √x = 2.
z-m-38-03.s.s2.o.c: An sami kuskure wajen ninkawa lokacin da aka rubuta (x−2)(x+1)=0, wanda ya ƙirƙiri ƙarin mafita
z-m-38-03.s.s2.r.c: Ninkawar da aka yi daidai ce. Wannan yana ɗaukar gaskiyar cewa ma'aunin ma'auni na biyu yana da mafita biyu a matsayin kuskuren lissafi.
z-m-38-03.s.s2.o.d: Ya isa kawai abin da ke ƙarƙashin tushen x+2 kada ya zama mara kyau, saboda haka a riƙe kowace mafita mai x ≥ −2 ko da an samo ta bayan ɗaga murabba'i
z-m-38-03.s.s2.r.d: Sharadin abin da ke ƙarƙashin tushen wajibi ne amma bai isa shi kaɗai ba. Dole ne a bincika dabam ko ainihin ma'aunin ya cika.
z-m-38-03.s.s2.o.e: √(x+2) ya kai 0 ko fiye, saboda haka x a ainihin ma'aunin ma dole ne ya kai 0 ko fiye; amma ma'aunin da aka ɗaga murabba'i ba shi da wannan sharadi
z-m-38-03.s.s2.r.e: Wannan bayani ya gane cewa sharadin tushen murabba'i ya kai 0 ko fiye yana kuma ɗora sharadi ga ɓangaren dama.

z-m-38-03.s.s3.prompt: Idan a cikakkiyar lamba ce mai kyau, ɗaga ɓangarorin biyu murabba'i na ma'aunin √(x+a) = x yana ba da x² − x − a = 0. Ƙirƙiri ƙimomi 3 daban-daban na a da ke sa tushen biyu na wannan ma'aunin na biyu su zama cikakkun lambobi. (A wannan yanayin, ɗaya daga cikin tushen biyun ba mafita ba ce ga ainihin ma'aunin.)
z-m-38-03.s.s3.hint.0: A kira tushen biyun r da s, sannan ka rubuta dangantakar jimillar r + s da ninkawar rs da a.
z-m-38-03.s.s3.hint.1: Gwada ƙananan cikakkun lambobi masu kyau na a ɗaya bayan ɗaya, ka bincika ko x² − x − a yana da ninkawa, sannan ka nemi tsarin ƙimomin a da suka yi aiki.

z-m-38-03.s.s3.fail.c2: Tushen x²−x−a=0 ba cikakkun lambobi ba ne. Duba ko discriminant 1+4a murabba'in wata cikakkiyar lamba ne.
z-m-38-03.s.s3.explain: A kira tushen biyun r da s. To r + s = 1 kuma rs = −a < 0, saboda haka tushe ɗaya tabbatacce ne ɗaya kuma mara kyau. Tushen mara kyau ba zai iya zama mafita ga ainihin ma'aunin ba domin √(x+a) ≥ 0. Domin tushen biyun su zama cikakkun lambobi, r(1−r) = −a, don haka a = r(r−1); misali a = 2 (tushe 2, −1), 6 (tushe 3, −2), 12 (tushe 4, −3), 20 (tushe 5, −4), ...

z-m-38-02.title: Shin maki biyu da suke da tsayi iri ɗaya sun isa su kayyade jadawalin?
z-m-38-02.topic: Nemo tsarin aikin quadratic, da kuma ko sharuddan sun wadatar.
z-m-38-02.goal: Ga aikin quadratic f(x)=ax²+bx+c mai f(0)=3 da f(4)=3, tsara abin da ya kamata a ƙara domin a kayyade tsarin lissafin guda ɗaya tak; ga sharuddan da ba su kayyade shi ba, ƙirƙiri tsarin lissafi da dama da suka cika duk sharuddan.
z-m-38-02.material: Ga aikin quadratic f(x) = ax² + bx + c (a ≠ 0; a, b, c constants ne; ana karantawa “a x murabba’i da b x da c”), an san abubuwa biyu. Jadawalin yana ratsa maki (0, 3) da (4, 3). Wato f(0) = 3 da f(4) = 3. Wannan bayani kaɗai bai wadatar ya kayyade tsarin f guda ɗaya tak ba. Za mu ƙara wani bayani guda.
z-m-38-02.thinking.2: Ƙirƙiri tsarin lissafi da dama da suka cika sharudda iri ɗaya.
z-m-38-02.prereq.1: Sanya maƙasudan maki a cikin quadratic y=ax²+bx+c domin samun dangantaka tsakanin coefficients.
z-m-38-02.prereq.2: Gaskiyar cewa maki biyu masu tsayi iri ɗaya suna daidaita juna game da axis ɗin daidaituwa.
z-m-38-02.prereq.3: Alamar discriminant b²−4ac da yawan maki da jadawalin yake haɗuwa da axis x.
z-m-38-02.s.s1.prompt: Daga bayanin da ke ƙasa, zaɓi duk ƙarin bayanan da idan aka ƙara guda ɗaya kawai za su kayyade tsarin f guda ɗaya tak.
z-m-38-02.s.s1.hint.0: Zaɓi wani ƙarin bayani guda daga cikin zaɓuɓɓuka, sannan ka ƙirƙiri tsarin lissafi biyu da suka cika wannan sharadi tare da f(0)=3 da f(4)=3. Idan za ka iya ƙirƙirar biyu, bayanin bai wadatar ba.
z-m-38-02.s.s1.hint.1: Da farko ka rubuta dangantakar da ke tsakanin coefficients b da a da ta samu daga f(0)=3 da f(4)=3.
z-m-38-02.s.s1.r.a: Wannan yana gaya maka kawai cewa a tabbatacce ne, saboda haka har yanzu akwai ƙimomi da dama masu yiwuwa na a. Idan ka gwada a = 1 da a = 2, dukansu suna yiwuwa.
z-m-38-02.s.s1.o.b: Mafi ƙarancin ƙimar f ita ce −1.
z-m-38-02.s.s1.r.b: Wannan zaɓin ya gane cewa akwai mafi ƙarancin ƙima, kuma haɗa shi da bayanan da aka sani yana ba ka damar nemo a.
z-m-38-02.s.s1.o.c: Jadawalin yana haɗuwa da axis x a maki biyu dabam-dabam.
z-m-38-02.s.s1.r.c: Wannan yana yiwuwa ba kawai idan a tabbatacce ba har ma idan mara kyau ne; ko da a tabbatacce ne, ƙimomi da dama na yiwuwa. Ba ka gwada ko ƙimomi da dama na a suna cika sharadin ba.
z-m-38-02.s.s1.r.d: Wannan zaɓin ya gane cewa sabon maki yana ƙara wata sabuwar dangantaka guda a tsarin, wadda take kayyade coefficient.
z-m-38-02.s.s1.o.e: Zanen ya ratsa ta wurin wurin (4, 3)
z-m-38-02.s.s1.r.e: Wannan kawai ya sake faɗin bayanin da aka riga aka bayar, saboda haka bai ƙara wata sabuwar alaƙa ba. Dole ne ka bambanta sabon bayani da abin da ka riga ka sani.
z-m-38-02.s.s1.explain: Idan f(0)=3 da f(4)=3, axis ɗin daidaito shi ne x = 2, kuma tsarin ƙa'idar f(x)=a(x−2)²+k ne. Idan mafi ƙarancin ƙima ita ce −1, to k = −1, a>0, kuma daga f(0)=4a−1=3 mun sami a=1. Idan wurin shi ne (1, 0), to a+k=0 da 4a+k=3, don haka a=1 da k=−1. Amma idan an ce 'yana buɗewa zuwa sama' kuma 'yana taɓa axis a wurare biyu', a na iya samun ƙimomi da dama, kuma wurin (4, 3) bayani ne da muka riga muka sani.
z-m-38-02.s.s2.prompt: Gina ayyukan ma'auni na biyu 3 daban-daban f(x) = ax² + bx + c, inda f(0) = 3 da f(4) = 3, kuma zane-zanensu ya taɓa axis x a wurare biyu daban-daban. (Shigar da a, b, c.)
z-m-38-02.s.s2.hint.0: Saka f(0)=3 da f(4)=3 cikin ƙa'idar, sannan da farko ka rubuta dangantakar a da b.

Saboda haka akwai ƙa'idoji marasa iyaka da suka cika duk sharuddan, kamar (1, −4, 3), (2, −8, 3), (−1, 4, 3). a = 0.5 ba ya aiki domin discriminant ɗin ba tabbatacce ba ne.

z-m-38-06.title: Idan an kayyade yankin da kewayon aiki, ayyukan quadratic nawa ne za a iya samu?
z-m-38-06.topic: Gano ƙimomin ma'aunai na aikin quadratic wanda aka kayyade yankinsa da kewayon aikinsa.
z-m-38-06.goal: Nemo adadin ma'aunai na f(x)=a(x−1)²+k waɗanda kewayon aikinsu yake 1 ≤ y ≤ 5 a yankin 0 ≤ x ≤ 3, kuma bayyana dalilin da ya sa shari'o'in suka kasu gida 2 da kuma dalilin da babu wasu.
z-m-38-06.material: Aikin quadratic f(x) = a(x − 1)² + k (a ≠ 0; a da k ƙayyadaddun lambobi ne na gaske; ana karantawa: 'a ninka (x cire 1) murabba'i sannan a ƙara k') yana da yankin 0 ≤ x ≤ 3 da kewayon aiki 1 ≤ y ≤ 5. Wato, a wannan tazara ƙarami shi ne 1, babba kuma 5. Lura: a x = 0, x = 1, x = 3 na yankin, ƙimomin aikin su ne a + k, k, 4a + k bi da bi. Minjun ya ce, “Akwai ƙaramin ƙima, saboda haka zanen yana buɗewa zuwa sama. Don haka akwai ma'aurata (a, k) guda ɗaya kawai.”
z-m-38-06.thinking.1: Raba shi zuwa shari'o'i kuma bincika su ba tare da barin ko ɗaya ba.
z-m-38-06.thinking.2: Rubuta dalilin da ya sa za a iya cewa babu wasu.
z-m-38-06.prereq.1: Alamar a da siffar zanen quadratic y=a(x−p)²+q.
z-m-38-06.prereq.2: A kan rufaffiyar tazara, matsakaicin da ƙaramin ƙima suna cikin ƙimomin kan kololuwa da iyakokin biyu.

z-m-38-06.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta inda babbar ƙima da ƙarama a tazara 0 ≤ x ≤ 3 suke faruwa idan a yana da kyau da kuma idan a yana da kyau mara kyau.
z-m-38-06.s.s1.hint.1: Zana jadawali da a mara kyau, sannan ka bincika ko kololuwar ita ce mafi girma ko mafi ƙasƙanci a tazarar.
z-m-38-06.s.s1.o.a: A'a. Ko da yana buɗewa zuwa ƙasa, ƙaramin ƙima 1 na iya faruwa a iyaka, don haka akwai yiwuwar samun wani ma'aurata.
z-m-38-06.s.s1.r.a: Wannan hukunci ya gane cewa idan tazara rufaffiya ce, ƙaramin ƙima na iya faruwa a iyakar da ba kololuwa ba.
z-m-38-06.s.s1.o.b: Daidai. Kewayon aikin yana da ƙaramin ƙima, don haka yana buɗewa zuwa sama, sannan akwai ma'aurata (a, k) guda ɗaya kawai.
z-m-38-06.s.s1.r.b: Ka rasa cewa rufaffiyar tazara koyaushe tana da ƙaramin ƙima. Kasancewar akwai ƙaramin ƙima ba ya ƙayyade alamar a.
z-m-38-06.s.s1.o.c: A'a. Ko a yana da kyau ko mara kyau, akwai ƙimomi marasa iyaka a jere, saboda haka akwai ma'aurata da dama marasa iyaka.
z-m-38-06.s.s1.r.c: Ka rasa cewa sharudda biyu (ƙaramin da babban ƙima) suna ƙayyade abubuwan da ba a sani ba guda biyu. Ba ka kafa lissafi ka warware ba.
z-m-38-06.s.s1.o.d: Daidai. Kololuwa tana cikin tazara, don haka k ya zama ƙaramin ƙima 1, sauran ma an ƙayyade su babu wata hanya, shi ke nan.
z-m-38-06.s.s1.r.d: Ka yi la'akari da shari'ar a mai kyau kawai. Idan a mara kyau ne, ƙimar k a kololuwa ce mafi girma.
z-m-38-06.s.s1.explain: Kololuwar x = 1 tana cikin tazara 0 ≤ x ≤ 3. Idan a > 0, ƙaramin ƙima shi ne k, babba kuma ƙimar 4a + k a iyakar x = 3. Idan a < 0, babba shi ne k, ƙarami kuma ƙimar 4a + k a iyakar x = 3. Dole ne a warware shari'o'in dabam-dabam.
z-m-38-06.s.s2.prompt: Nemo ka shigar da ma'aurata (a, k) da yawa gwargwadon iko waɗanda kewayon aikinsu a yankin 0 ≤ x ≤ 3 yake 1 ≤ y ≤ 5. Kana buƙatar aƙalla ma'aurata 2 daban-daban. (Ba za mu gaya maka matsakaicin adadin ma'auratan ba.)

z-m-38-06.s.s3.prompt: A cikin kalmominka, rubuta dalilin da ya sa ka tabbata babu wasu ma'aurata (a, k) ban da waɗanda aka samu a sama. Haka kuma za ka iya rubuta inda maganar Minjun ta gaza.

z-m-38-05.title: Idan muka ninka ayyuka biyu masu ƙaruwa, shin samfurin nasu ma koyaushe yana ƙaruwa?
z-m-38-05.topic: Ayyuka masu ƙaruwa da samfurinsu: gina misalan karya daga samfuran ayyukan layi, da sharuddan da da'awar take aiki a ƙarƙashinsu
z-m-38-05.goal: Gwada da'awar 'samfurin ayyuka biyu masu ƙaruwa yana ƙaruwa', gina misalan karya daban-daban da ayyukan layi, sannan ka zaɓi sharuddan da da'awar take aiki a ƙarƙashinsu.
z-m-38-05.material: Akwai ayyuka biyu f da g waɗanda yankinsu ya ƙunshi duk lambobin ainihi. 'Mai ƙaruwa' na nufin idan x₁ < x₂, to f(x₁) < f(x₂). Seoa ta ce, 'Idan f da g duka ayyuka ne masu ƙaruwa, to samfurin h(x) = f(x)·g(x) ma aiki ne mai ƙaruwa.' Seoa ta ɗauki f(x) = x + 1 da g(x) = 2x + 1, sannan ta lissafa h idan x = 1, 2, 3. h(1) = 6, h(2) = 15, h(3) = 28.
z-m-38-05.thinking.0: Gwada da'awa (kada a ayyana gaskiyarta daga misalai kaɗan)
z-m-38-05.thinking.2: Amfani da misalan karya domin tantancewa da zaɓar sharuddan da da'awar take aiki a ƙarƙashinsu
z-m-38-05.prereq.1: Ma'anar aikin da yake ƙaruwa (idan x₁<x₂, to f(x₁)<f(x₂))
z-m-38-05.prereq.2: Lissafa ƙimomin ayyukan layi da samfurinsu (x+m)(x+n)
z-m-38-05.prereq.3: Gaskiyar cewa misalin karya guda ɗaya ya isa ya nuna da'awa ƙarya ce
z-m-38-05.s.s1.prompt: Idan aka duba lissafin Seoa, wace magana ce ta fi dacewa game da da'awarta?
z-m-38-05.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta kewayon x da Seoa ta gwada, sannan ka kwatanta shi da yankin aikin gaba ɗaya.
z-m-38-05.s.s1.hint.1: Ga f(x) = x + 1 da g(x) = 2x + 1, nemo ƙimomin h idan x = −3, −2, −1, 0 ma.
z-m-38-05.s.s1.o.a: Ƙimomin h sun ƙaru a jere idan x = 1, 2, 3, saboda haka muna ɗaukar da'awar gaskiya ce
z-m-38-05.s.s1.r.a: Ka ƙara da'awar cewa ƙimomi 3 sun ƙaru zuwa dukkan yankin. Domin aiki ya zama mai ƙaruwa, dole ne wannan ya tabbata ga duk x₁<x₂.
z-m-38-05.s.s1.o.b: Tun da f da g dukansu ayyuka ne masu ƙaruwa, kai tsaye za a iya cewa samfurin yana ƙaruwa, don haka babu buƙatar dubawa.
z-m-38-05.s.s1.r.b: Ka amince da wannan da'awar maimakon ka ɗauke ta a matsayin abin dubawa. Ba kamar jimla ba, alamomin lamba suna shafar samfur.
z-m-38-05.s.s1.o.c: An gwada ƙimomin x masu kyau kawai, don haka yana da wuya a ce gaskiya ne kafin a ga ƙimomin ɓangaren mara kyau ma.
z-m-38-05.s.s1.r.c: Wannan hukunci yana bambanta zangon da aka gwada da dukkan yankin, sannan ya yanke shawarar inda za a ƙara gwadawa.
z-m-38-05.s.s1.o.d: Ƙimomi suna ƙaruwa da sauri, kamar h(3)=28, don haka za mu iya ɗaukar samfurin a matsayin mai ƙaruwa.
z-m-38-05.s.s1.r.d: Ka mai da hankali kan yadda ƙimomin ke ƙaruwa. Da'awar ba ta shafi girman ƙaruwa ba, tana nufin ƙaruwa a kowane x.
z-m-38-05.s.s1.explain: A x = −3, −2, −1, 0, h yana da ƙimomi 10, 3, 0, 1. Daga x = −3 zuwa −2, h yana raguwa daga 10 zuwa 3. Misalin Seoa ya gwada ɓangaren mai kyau kawai, don haka ba za mu iya sanin ko da'awar gaskiya ce ba; a zahiri da'awar ba ta cika ko a wannan misali ba.
z-m-38-05.s.s2.prompt: Ayyukan f(x) = x + m da g(x) = x + n (m ≤ n) duk suna ƙaruwa. Yanzu ƙirƙiri misalai inda samfurin h(x) = f(x)·g(x) ba ya ƙaruwa. Wato, sa h(p) > h(q) ga wasu lambobi p < q. Yi misalai 3 masu (m, n) daban-daban.
z-m-38-05.s.s2.hint.0: Bayan ka zaɓi m da n, yi jadawalin ƙimomin h(x) a x = −3, −2, −1, 0, 1, sannan ka nemi inda ƙimomin suke raguwa.
z-m-38-05.s.s2.hint.1: Idan ka sami wurin da ƙimomi ke raguwa, rubuta waɗannan ƙimomin x biyu a matsayin p da q. Canja m da n, ka gwada ko wasu (m, n) ma suna da wurin da ƙimomi ke raguwa.
z-m-38-05.s.s2.ok.c1: m bai fi n girma ba (domin kada a ƙirga ma'auratan ayyuka iri ɗaya sau biyu ta hanyar musanya sunayensu kawai).
z-m-38-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Ka sa m ≤ n (domin kada a ƙirga misali ɗaya sau biyu idan an musanya f da g).
z-m-38-05.s.s2.ok.c3: p < q amma h(p) > h(q). h ba ya ƙaruwa.
z-m-38-05.s.s2.fail.c3: h(p) bai fi h(q) girma ba. Ka lissafta da kanka yadda ƙimar samfurin take canzawa.
z-m-38-05.s.s2.explain: Misali, idan f(x) = g(x) = x (m = n = 0), to h(x) = x² kuma h(−2) = 4 > h(−1) = 1. Idan f(x) = x + 1 kuma g(x) = x + 3 (m = 1, n = 3), to h(−3) = (−2)(0) = 0 > h(−2) = (−1)(1) = −1. Misali guda na karyatawa ya isa ya rushe da'awar. A inda ƙimomin waɗannan furuci biyu na layi suke da kyau mara kyau, samfurin na iya raguwa yayin da x ke ƙaruwa.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.prompt: Muna so mu ƙara sharadi domin da'awar Seoa ta kasance gaskiya koyaushe. Wane sharadi ya dace?
z-m-38-05.s.s3.hint.0: Ga kowane sharadi, gwada ko za ka iya ƙirƙirar ayyuka biyu da suka cika sharadin amma samfurinsu ba ya ƙaruwa.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.hint.1: Domin kwatanta f(p)g(p) da f(q)g(q) idan p < q, yi tunanin wane alama lambobin da ke ninka f(p) < f(q) da g(p) < g(q) ya kamata su kasance da ita.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.o.a: Zanen f da g duk suna wucewa ta asali kuma suna tashi zuwa sama da dama.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.r.a: f(x) = g(x) = x aiki ne mai ƙaruwa da ke wucewa ta asali, amma h(x) = x² yana raguwa idan x < 0. Ba ka ƙirƙiri misalin karyatawa don gwada shi ba.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.o.b: Ƙimomin aikin f(0) da g(0) a x = 0 dukansu masu kyau ne.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.r.b: Ka rasa yiwuwar cewa ƙimar na iya zama mai kyau a x = 0 kawai, sannan ta zama mara kyau a sauran x. Gwada f(x) = g(x) = x + 1 a x = −3, −2.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.o.c: Ka ɗauki yankin a matsayin an rage shi zuwa ɓangaren da x > 0.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.r.c: Ko da yankin yana da kyau, ƙimomin aikin na iya zama marasa kyau. Gwada f(x) = g(x) = x − 5 a x = 1, 2.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.o.d: A kowane x a yankin, f(x) da g(x) dukansu masu kyau ne.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.r.d: Wannan zaɓin yana bambanta yankin da ƙimomin aiki, kuma ya gane cewa alamomin lambobin da ake ninkawa suna da muhimmanci wajen kwatanta samfurori.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.explain: Idan p < q, to 0 < f(p) < f(q) da 0 < g(p) < g(q), don haka f(p)g(p) < f(q)g(p) < f(q)g(q). Misalin karyatawa na a shi ne f = g = x (h yana da ƙimomi 4, 1 a x = −2, −1), na b shi ne f = g = x + 1 (h yana da ƙimomi 4, 1 a x = −3, −2), na c kuma shi ne f = g = x − 5 (h yana da ƙimomi 16, 9 a x = 1, 2).

z-m-38-01.title: Yayin da yankin ma’anar yake ƙaruwa, ta yaya mafi girma da mafi ƙanƙanta suke motsawa?
z-m-38-01.topic: Mafi girma da mafi ƙanƙanta na aikin quadratic idan yankin ma’anar ya canza.
z-m-38-01.goal: Yayin da ƙarshen yankin k yake canzawa, ka bincika da jadawalin ƙimomi yadda wurin samun mafi girma da mafi ƙanƙanta (ƙoli ko ƙarshen yankin) yake canzawa, sannan ka sake bayyana hasashenka na farko.
z-m-38-01.material: Ga aikin quadratic f(x) = x² − 4x + 3 (ana karantawa: “x murabba’i a cire 4x a ƙara 3”). Sanya yankin ma’anar ya zama 0 ≤ x ≤ k (k lamba ce ta ainihi mai kyau), canza k, sannan ka duba mafi girma da mafi ƙanƙanta na f a wannan yankin. Seoyeon ta yi hasashen: “Idan tazara ta faɗaɗa, mafi ƙanƙanta zai ragu kuma mafi girma zai ƙaru.” Za a bayyana jadawalin ƙimomi ɗaya bayan ɗaya, mataki-mataki.
z-m-38-01.thinking.0: Gwada hasashe ta amfani da jadawalin ƙimomi a matsayin shaida.
z-m-38-01.thinking.1: Riƙe ko gyara hukuncinka yayin da sabon bayani yake zuwa.
z-m-38-01.thinking.2: Bayyana da tazara yadda ƙarshe yake canzawa idan sharadi (yankin ma’anar) ya canza.
z-m-38-01.prereq.0: H1 na wannan aiki yana nuna matakin wahala da aka ware a lokacin samarwa kawai; ba ya nufin tsarin karatu ya sanya wannan abun cikin a aji 1 na sakandare ba. A ɗauka cewa an riga an koyi abubuwan da ake bukata a ƙasa.
z-m-38-01.prereq.1: Sake rubuta aikin quadratic a sigar y=a(x−p)²+q domin nemo ƙoli (cika murabba’i).
z-m-38-01.prereq.2: Siffar jadawalin aikin quadratic da axis ɗin daidaituwarsa.
z-m-38-01.prereq.3: Lissafa ƙimar aikin da kanka domin ƙirƙirar jadawalin ƙimomi.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.prompt: Za a bayyana jadawalin ƙimomi ɗaya bayan ɗaya. A kowane mataki, ka yanke hukunci daga bayanan da aka samu zuwa yanzu; idan sabon bayani ya bayyana, ka riƙe ko ka gyara hukuncin. (Yankin ma’anar koyaushe 0 ≤ x ≤ k ne.)
z-m-38-01.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta nau’in (x, f(x)) daga jadawalin da aka bayyana, sannan ka yi alama inda mafi ƙanƙanta da mafi girma suke faruwa.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.hint.1: Sake rubuta f(x) a sigar (x−□)²+□, sannan ka bincika ko x ɗin da mafi ƙanƙanta yake faruwa a kansa yana cikin yankin ma’anar.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Wannan shi ne jadawalin ƙimomi idan k = 1 (0 ≤ x ≤ 1). Idan x = 0, f = 3; idan x = 0.5, f = 1.25; idan x = 1, f = 0. A wannan tazarar mafi ƙanƙanta 0 ne, mafi girma kuma 3 ne.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Idan muka ci gaba da ƙara k fiye da 1, me kake tsammanin zai faru da mafi ƙanƙanta? (Yi hasashe ta amfani da jadawali da tsarin lissafi da aka gani zuwa yanzu kawai.)
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Tare da jadawali uku kawai, hasashe a da b duk suna yiwuwa. Idan ka yi tunanin siffar aikin (yana buɗewa zuwa sama), b ya dace; idan ka duba raguwar ƙimomi kawai, za ka zaɓi a. Bari mu gwada da jadawali na gaba.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Yayin da k yake ƙaruwa, mafi ƙanƙanta yana ci gaba da raguwa.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ka ci gaba daga yanayin raguwar ƙimomi kawai. Aikin quadratic yana canza alkibla a wani wuri, saboda haka dole ne ka bincika ko wannan wurin yana cikin tazarar.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Daga wani ƙimar k zuwa gaba, wataƙila zai daina raguwa.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wannan hasashen ya samo asali ne daga tuna cewa jadawalin yana buɗewa zuwa sama, saboda haka yana da mafi ƙanƙanta. Dole ne a bincika da jadawali inda wannan wurin yake.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ko wane k ne, mafi ƙanƙanta yana nan darajar 0.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ka duba ƙimomin cikin tazarar kawai, ba tare da tunanin ƙimomin wajen tazarar ba. Idan tazara ta faɗaɗa, sababbin ƙimomin x suna shiga.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Wannan shi ne jadawalin ƙimomi idan k = 3 (0 ≤ x ≤ 3). Idan x = 1, f = 0; idan x = 2, f = −1; idan x = 3, f = 0. Haka kuma idan x = 2.5, f = −0.75. Mafi ƙanƙanta shi ne −1.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.ask: Idan muka ƙara k gaba, zuwa k = 5 ko k = 10, me zai faru da mafi ƙanƙanta?
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Tun da f(x) = (x−2)² − 1, mafi ƙanƙantar ƙima −1 tana faruwa idan x = 2, kuma idan x ya fi 2 ƙima za ta sake ƙaruwa. Saboda haka duk lokacin da k ya kai 2 ko ya fi haka, mafi ƙanƙanta iri ɗaya ne, −1. Idan ka fara zaɓar a, nuna jadawalin da ya canza hasashenka.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Yana ci gaba da raguwa, kamar −2, −3.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ba ka lura cewa ƙimomi suna sake ƙaruwa bayan x ya wuce 2 ba. Ka kwatanta ƙimomin kafin da bayan x = 2 a jadawalin.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wannan hukunci ya karanta daga jadawali cewa ƙima ta fi ƙanƙanta idan x = 2, sannan ta ƙaru bayan haka.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Daga k = 3 zuwa gaba, mafi ƙanƙanta yana ƙaruwa a zahiri.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Idan tazara ta faɗaɗa, mafi ƙanƙanta zai iya raguwa ko ya kasance iri ɗaya kawai; ba zai iya ƙaruwa ba. Ka manta cewa duk ƙimomin tsohuwar tazara suna nan cikin sabuwar tazara mai faɗi.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Idan k = 4 (0 ≤ x ≤ 4): idan x = 0, f = 3, kuma idan x = 4, f = 3, saboda haka ƙimomin ƙarshen tazarar biyu iri ɗaya ne. Mafi girma shi ne 3. Idan muka faɗaɗa zuwa k = 5, f = 8 a x = 5 ya zama sabon mafi girma.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Yaya ya kamata a gyara hasashen Seoyeon cewa “idan tazara ta faɗaɗa, mafi girma yana ƙaruwa”?
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Idan 0 ≤ k ≤ 4, f(k) ≤ 3, saboda haka mafi girma f(0) = 3 ne; daga k > 4 kuma f(k) ya fi 3 girma. Hasashen Seoyeon daidai ne ne kawai idan k < 2 ga mafi ƙanƙanta, kuma idan k > 4 ga mafi girma. Zangon da yake daidai yana rabuwa bisa sharadin (tazara).
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Da zarar k ya ƙaru, mafi girma ma yana ƙaruwa, don haka Seoyeon ta yi daidai kamar yadda ta ce.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ba ka bincika cewa mafi girma yana nan 3 idan k = 3 da k = 4 ba. Dole ne ka kwatanta ko sabbin ƙimomin x da aka ƙara suna ba da wani abu mafi girma fiye da tsohon mafi girma.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ko da k ya ƙaru sosai, mafi girma yana nan 3.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ka manta cewa f(5) = 8 yana bayyana idan k = 5. Dole ne ka bincika ko ƙimar ƙarshen tazara tana ci gaba da ƙaruwa.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Har sai k ya kai 4, mafi girma yana nan 3; yana ƙaruwa ne kawai bayan k ya wuce 4.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wannan hukunci yana kwatanta wanne daga ƙarshen tazarar biyu, x = 0 ko x = k, yake da ƙima mafi girma.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.reflect: Wasu sun fara hasashen cewa “mafi ƙanƙanta yana ci gaba da raguwa”, sannan suka canza ra’ayinsu bayan ganin jadawalin bayan x = 2; wasu kuma sun yi hasashen “wataƙila zai daina” kuma suka riƙe wannan hasashe. A layi guda, ka faɗi jadawalin da ya canza (ko ya tabbatar da) hukuncinka.
z-m-38-01.s.s2.prompt: A yankin ma’anar 0 ≤ x ≤ k, zaɓi k da (mafi girma) − (mafi ƙanƙanta) = 4. (k lamba ce ta ainihi mai kyau.)
z-m-38-01.s.s2.hint.0: Ga k = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, tsara mafi girma da mafi ƙanƙanta a jadawali, sannan ka nemo bambancinsu.
z-m-38-01.s.s2.hint.1: Yi alama ga ƙimomin k a jadawalin da bambancin ya zama 4, sannan ka gwada ko haka yake ga ƙimomin k da ke tsakaninsu (misali 2.5 da 3.5).
z-m-38-01.s.s2.o.a: Bambancin yana zama 4 ne kawai idan k = 4, ba ga wani k ba.
z-m-38-01.s.s2.r.a: Ka bincika cewa bambancin 4 ne idan k = 4 kawai, ba tare da gwada ƙimomin da ke kusa da shi ba (misali 3.5).
z-m-38-01.s.s2.o.b: Bambancin yana zama 4 ne kawai idan k = 3, ba ga wani k ba.
z-m-38-01.s.s2.r.b: Ka bincika cewa yana aiki a ƙima guda kawai, ba tare da gwada ƙimomin da ke kewaye da ita ba.
z-m-38-01.s.s2.o.c: Bambancin 4 ne ga kowace lambar ainihi k da ta kai 4 ko ta fi haka (daga k = 4 zuwa gaba).
z-m-38-01.s.s2.r.c: Ba ka bincika cewa idan k = 5, mafi girma 8 ne kuma mafi ƙanƙanta −1 ne ba, saboda haka bambancin 9 ne.
z-m-38-01.s.s2.o.d: Bambancin 4 ne ga kowace lambar ainihi k daga 2 zuwa 4.
z-m-38-01.s.s2.r.d: Wannan hukunci ya gano zangon da mafi ƙanƙanta yake nan −1, mafi girma kuma nan 3 a tazarar.
z-m-38-01.s.s2.explain: Idan 2 ≤ k ≤ 4, mafi ƙanƙanta −1 ne (a x = 2), mafi girma kuma 3 ne (a x = 0), saboda haka bambancin 4 ne. Idan k < 2, mafi ƙanƙanta ya fi −1 girma, don haka bambancin bai kai 4 ba; idan k > 4, mafi girma f(k) ya fi 3 girma, don haka bambancin ya fi 4.

z-m-38-04.prereq.0: H1 na wannan aiki yana nuna matakin wahala da aka ware a lokacin samarwa kawai; ba ya nufin tsarin karatu ya sanya wannan abun cikin a aji 1 na sakandare ba. A ɗauka cewa an riga an koyi abubuwan da ake bukata a ƙasa.
z-m-38-04.title: Idan ƙa'idoji biyu suka dace da duk bayanan ukun, wacce ya kamata mu yarda da ita?
z-m-38-04.topic: Zaɓar ƙa'idar da ta dace da bayanai (kwatanta akasin rabo da aikin ma'auni na biyu)
z-m-38-04.goal: Kwatanta nau'ikan ƙa'idoji biyu da suka ratsa wuraren bayanai guda uku, ka yanke shawarar wacce za ka yarda da ita da kuma matakin yarda bisa sabon awo da tsarin yanayin, sannan ka bayyana kewayon da ka yarda da ita.
z-m-38-04.material: An zuba ruwa 12 L daidai-wa-daida cikin kwalabe iri ɗaya guda x (x cikakkiyar lamba ce mai kyau), sannan aka auna yawan ruwan y (L) a cikin kwalba guda. Bayanai: kwalba 1, 12 L; kwalabe 2, 6 L; kwalabe 3, 4 L. Abokai biyu sun ba da ƙa'idoji. Jiwon: y = 12/x (ana karantawa '12 raba da x'). Hyunwoo: y = 2x² − 12x + 22 (ana karantawa '2 x murabba'i a cire 12x a ƙara 22'). Ruwan ba ya zubewa, kuma ana raba shi daidai-wa-daida tsakanin kwalaben.
z-m-38-04.thinking.0: Yi lissafi da kanka domin duba ko bayanai da ƙirar lissafi sun yi daidai
z-m-38-04.thinking.1: Daidaita ƙarfin amincewa yayin da sabon shaida ke bayyana
z-m-38-04.thinking.2: Bambance abin da ya dace da bayanai da abin da ya dace da yanayin
z-m-38-04.prereq.1: Nemo ƙimar aiki (saka x a cikin ƙa'ida sannan a lissafa)
z-m-38-04.prereq.2: Karanta ƙa'idodin aikin ma'auni na biyu da na aiki rabo y=k/x
z-m-38-04.prereq.3: Dangantakar (yawan kwalabe) × (yawan ruwa a kowace kwalba) = jimillar ruwa
z-m-38-04.s.s1.prompt: Idan aka duba bayanai ukun da ke sama kaɗai, zaɓi magana mafi dacewa.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.hint.0: Saka x = 1, 2, 3 cikin kowace ƙa'ida biyu sannan ka kwatanta da bayanan a cikin jadawali.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunani ko ƙa'idar da ta ratsa wurare uku ita kaɗai ce, ko kuwa akwai yiwuwar ƙa'idoji da dama.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.o.a: y=12/x ya fi sauƙi, saboda haka waɗannan bayanai kaɗai sun isa a kammala cewa ƙa'idar Jiwon daidai ce
z-m-38-04.s.s1.r.a: Ka ɗauki 'ƙa'idar tana da sauƙi' a matsayin shaida. Sauƙin ƙa'ida na iya zama dalilin yarda da ita, amma bayanai ba su tabbatar da hakan ba.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.o.b: y=2x²−12x+22 tana da ma'aunan cikakkun lambobi, saboda haka ta fi daidaito kuma ƙa'idar Hyunwoo ce daidai
z-m-38-04.s.s1.r.b: Ka duba daidaito daga yadda ma'aunan suke kama. Ana iya sanin ko ƙa'ida ta dace da bayanai ne kawai ta hanyar saka ƙimomi.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.o.c: Ƙa'idojin biyu sun dace da bayanai ukun, saboda haka waɗannan bayanai kaɗai ba za su nuna wacce daidai ba
z-m-38-04.s.s1.r.c: Wannan hukuncin ya fahimci cewa idan ƙa'idoji biyu suka dace da bayanai iri ɗaya, bayanan kaɗai ba za su bambanta su ba.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.o.d: Ƙa'idar da ta ratsa wurare uku guda ɗaya ce, saboda haka ɗaya daga cikin biyun lissafinta ba daidai ba ne
z-m-38-04.s.s1.r.d: Ka yi imani cewa ƙa'idar da ta ratsa wurare uku guda ɗaya ce. Ko da aikin ma'auni na biyu ya ratsa wurare uku, wata ƙa'ida ta wani nau'i dabam ma za ta iya ratsa wuraren iri ɗaya.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.explain: Idan aka saka x = 1, 2, 3, ƙa'idojin biyun suna ba da 12, 6, 4, wanda ya dace da bayanan. Tun da ƙa'idoji biyu sun dace da bayanai iri ɗaya, bayanan kaɗai ba za su bambanta su ba. Domin yanke shawarar wacce za a yarda da ita, ana buƙatar wasu dalilai, kamar sabon awo ko tsarin yanayin.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.prompt: Za a bayyana sabon bayani a hankali, kashi-kashi. A kowane mataki, yanke shawarar yadda amincewarka da ƙa'idojin biyun za ta canja.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.hint.0: Saka adadin kwalaben x da aka bayyana cikin ƙa'idojin biyun, ka nemo ƙimomin da suke hasashe da kanka, sannan ka kwatanta da ƙimar da aka auna.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.hint.1: Idan ƙimar da aka auna ta bambanta da hasashen, ka yi tunani kan yiwuwar biyun: ƙa'idar ba daidai ba ce ko ma'aunin ba daidai ba ne.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.info: Mun raba ruwan cikin kwalabe 4 kuma muka auna ruwan da ke kwalba ɗaya: 3 L ne.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.ask: Idan ka kwatanta wannan ƙimar da aka auna da hasashen ƙa'idojin biyun, me ka kammala game da ƙa'idojin?
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.after: Ƙa'idar Jiwon tana hasashen 3 L idan x = 4, ta Hyunwoo kuma tana hasashen 6 L. Ƙimar 3 L da aka auna ta dace da ƙa'idar Jiwon kuma ta bambanta sosai da ta Hyunwoo. Ya dace a yarda da ƙa'idar Jiwon nan take; haka kuma ya dace a sake aunawa saboda yiwuwar kuskuren awo.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.o.a: Wataƙila ma'aunin ba daidai ba ne, saboda haka a sake aunawa sannan a yanke shawara
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.r.a: Wannan hali ne na taka-tsantsan: ba a yi saurin yanke hukunci daga ƙimar awo guda ba, ana son a sake tabbatarwa.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.o.b: Ka fi yarda da ƙa'idar Jiwon
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.r.b: Wannan hukuncin ya fi yarda da ƙa'idar da hasashenta ya fi kusa da ƙimar da aka auna.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.o.c: Ka fi yarda da ƙa'idar Hyunwoo
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.r.c: Wannan hukuncin bai bincika ƙimar da ƙa'idar Hyunwoo take bayarwa idan x = 4 ba.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.info: An auna 2 L idan kwalabe 6 ne, da 1 L idan kwalabe 12 ne. (Ya zuwa yanzu, bayanai 5 ne.)
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.ask: Wace hanya ce ta dace wajen bayyana amincewarka da ƙa'idar Jiwon y = 12/x?
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.after: Yayin da bayanai ke ƙaruwa, amincewarka da ƙa'idar Jiwon na ƙaruwa. Amma bayanai 5 kaɗai ba za su tabbatar da kowace ƙimar x ba. Idan akwai dalili (tsarin yanayin), amincewarka za ta iya ƙarfafa.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.o.a: Dukkan bayanai 5 daidai ne, saboda haka za mu iya cewa ƙa'idar daidai ce ga kowace cikakkiyar lamba mai kyau x
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.r.a: Ka faɗaɗa 'bayanan sun yi daidai sau 5' zuwa duk yanayi. Har yanzu ba a gwada ƙimomin x da ba a auna ba.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.o.b: Ko da yawan bayanan da suka dace ya ƙaru, amincewarmu ba ta canja ko kaɗan
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.r.b: Wannan bai la'akari da cewa sabon awo shaida ce da ke nuna alkibla iri ɗaya ba.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.o.c: Amincewarmu ta ƙaru domin bayanai 5 sun dace, amma har yanzu ana buƙatar wani dalili dabam domin a ce hakan ya shafi ƙimomin x da ba a auna ba
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.r.c: Wannan hukuncin ya ce shaida tana ƙarfafa amincewa, amma ana buƙatar dalili domin gama-garin da'awar dukkan yanayi.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.info: Idan ka ninka yawan kwalabe da yawan ruwan da ke cikin kwalba ɗaya, koyaushe za ka sami jimillar 12 L. Hakan ya faru ne domin ruwan ba ya zubewa kuma ana raba shi daidai-wa-daida tsakanin kwalaben.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.ask: Da sanin wannan, me za ka iya cewa game da ƙa'idar Jiwon y = 12/x?
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.after: Tun da x·y = 12, y = 12/x ya biyo kai tsaye daga yanayin, ba daga bayanai ba. Saboda haka za mu iya cewa yana aiki ga kowace cikakkiyar lamba mai kyau x idan aka ɗauka cewa 'ruwan ba ya zubewa kuma ana raba shi daidai-wa-daida'. Idan zato ya sauya (idan ruwa ya zuba), ƙa'idar ma za ta canja.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.o.a: Ba saboda bayanai kaɗai ba, har ma saboda tsarin yanayin, za mu iya cewa y=12/x ga kowace cikakkiyar lamba mai kyau x, matuƙar ruwan ba ya zubewa kuma ana raba shi daidai-wa-daida
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.r.a: Wannan hukuncin ya kafa iyakar amincewa ta amfani da dalilai biyun tare: shaida daga bayanai da tsarin yanayin.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.o.b: Dole ne har yanzu mu dogara da bayanai 5 kaɗai; tsarin yanayin ba dalili ba ne
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.r.b: Ka rasa cewa dangantakar da ta samo asali daga yanayin (ninkin ya kasance tsayayye) ce ke ƙayyade ƙa'idar kai tsaye.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.o.c: Ƙa'idar Hyunwoo ta yi sa'a ta ratsa wurare ukun, saboda haka ƙa'idar Jiwon ba daidai ba ce
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.r.c: Ratsa wurare ukun da ƙa'idar Hyunwoo ta yi ba yana nufin ƙa'idar Jiwon ba daidai ba ce ba. Ƙa'idarsa ba ta dace da tsarin yanayin idan aka yi amfani da wasu ƙimomin x.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.reflect: A s1 ka yanke cewa 'ba za mu iya bambance su ba'; wasu sun canja ra'ayinsu bayan ganin awo na kwalabe 4, wasu kuma sun ci gaba da ra'ayinsu da cewa 'a sake aunawa'. Ka bayyana ko dalilin canja ko riƙe hukuncinka shi ne ƙimar da aka auna ko tsarin yanayin.
z-m-38-04.s.s3.prompt: Hyunwoo ya ce, 'Duk da haka, aikin ma'auni na biyu ya dace da bayanai ukun, saboda haka wataƙila zai yi daidai daga baya.' Ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa ƙa'idar Hyunwoo ba ta dace da wannan yanayin ba, ta amfani da aƙalla lamba guda.
z-m-38-04.s.s3.hint.0: Saka x = 4, 6, 10 da sauransu cikin ƙa'idar Hyunwoo domin nemo ƙimomin da take hasashe, sannan ka duba ko ƙimomin suna yiwuwa a ainihin yanayin.
z-m-38-04.s.s3.hint.1: Kwatanta yadda yawan ruwa a kwalba ɗaya ya kamata ya canja yayin da yawan kwalabe ke ƙaruwa da yadda ƙimar ƙa'idar ke canjawa.
z-m-38-04.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: Idan x = ..., ƙa'idar Hyunwoo tana ba da ... L, amma ...
z-m-38-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Lambar da ka bayar ƙima ce da ka lissafa ta hanyar saka ta cikin ƙa'idar Hyunwoo?
z-m-38-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa ƙimar ba ta dace da yanayin ba (idan kwalabe sun ƙaru, yawan ruwa ya kamata ya ragu; ba zai iya wuce jimillar ruwan ba; da sauransu)?
z-m-38-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka fahimci kuma ka rubuta dalilin da ya sa 'ta dace da wurare uku' ba hujja ta isa ba?
z-m-38-04.s.s3.model.0: Idan x=4, ƙa'idar Hyunwoo tana ba da 6 L, amma ainihin awo ya nuna 3 L. Haka kuma, ba ta dace da yanayin ba cewa yawan ruwan kwalba ɗaya ya sake ƙaruwa bayan an ƙara yawan kwalabe. Saboda haka ko da ta dace da wurare uku, bai kamata mu yi amfani da wannan ƙa'ida ba.
z-m-38-04.s.s3.model.1: Idan x=10, ƙa'idar Hyunwoo tana ba da 2×100−120+22=102 L, wanda ya fi jimillar ruwan 12 L. Ta dace da bayanai ukun amma ba ta dace da wasu ƙimomi ba, saboda haka ba za a iya yarda da ita ba.
z-m-38-04.s.s3.modelNote.1: Wannan amsar ta yi amfani da ƙimar da ba za ta yiwu ba a yanayin a matsayin dalili, maimakon ƙimar da aka auna.
